calls.title: Improving our renewals data
calls.summary: The team addressed the critical issue of $2.5 million in untracked ARR due to 72 missing renewal deals. Jeff Ignacio highlighted serious revenue gaps after reconciling data from Stripe and HubSpot. Confusion stemmed from multiple data sources, creating inefficiencies in renewal tracking, as explained by Chris Sanders. A strategy was established to merge data sources, prioritizing high-value accounts for renewal outreach, with Carrie as the designated account manager. Proactive communication with customers whose renewals are due in the next 120 days aims to reduce churn. The next steps include a detailed cleanup and process standardization plan led by Charlie Campo, while regular updates will ensure progress monitoring.
calls.keywords: Renewals, Data Reconciliation, HubSpot, Retool, Stripe, License Management
